column1: # Same columns and meaning as bench/riscv/experiments.tsv:
# build   native  (= -march=native; the only x86 build)
# threads OpenMP thread count, 1 for serial kernels
#   autovec    scalar_f32, the same source with the vectorizer on, 1 thread
#   intrinsic  avx512_f32, the port of rvv_f32_m2, 1 thread
# RISC-V also runs rvv_f32_m1 and rvv_f32_m4. AVX-512 has a fixed 16 fp32
# lanes, the width of m2 at the X60's VLEN of 256, so those two have no
# faithful x86 counterpart and are left out.
# The autovec and intrinsic rows keep cflags "-" exactly as the RISC-V rows
# do, and so share one build, as they do on RISC-V.
# The omp rows use the same cflags and thread counts as the RISC-V omp rows.
# Threads are pinned one per physical core by run_bench.sh.
